# P36.15 — Redaction pipeline, wired end to end (PUB-015/016)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-PUB-015** (owner — the redaction pipeline is now a
real wired path, not a helper: proposal → recorded human review → apply →
derivative capture) · **SIG-PUB-016** (owner — the removed spans are physically
absent from the derivative's bytes and its extracted text layer, proven by
extraction tests; no overlays) · **SIG-EVID-011** (cited — the derivative is a
new capture carrying `parent_capture_id`, `redaction_method`,
`redaction_version`, its own digest) · **SIG-EPIS-006** (cited — the parent's
bytes are write-once and never touched; a re-redaction is a new derivative,
never an edit) · **SIG-PUB-014a** (cited — the review stays a human act on the
curation mechanism; the record binds digests, never the removed text) ·
**SIG-GOV-007** (cited — the §45.2 replace-in-place outcome stays compatible:
suppression acts on a new capture, never in place).

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/287_P36.15__redaction-pipeline.md` (manifest row 287,
Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; `R11-SAFE-04`, F2a §5 group 3) ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.39a-live-1` (`e20c8add`) ·
**Branch:** `r11/P36.15-redaction-pipeline` ·
**OM-20 posture:** none — code, fixtures and tests only; no hosted-store write,
no capture is redacted, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked, **no
redaction decision is made or claimed**. Live legs: none
(`live_verification=false`).

## Why

`redact()` existed with no non-test caller, there was no review record on a
redaction, and `public_representation` served a `public` capture's excerpt raw.
This row wires the pipeline: a review-gated apply step, the derivative written
as a new OCFL object, and every excerpt surface reading the derivative where
one exists.

## What ships

- **`evidence/src/evidence/redaction.py`** — the text-layer machinery:
  `decode_document`/`extract_text` (the SIG-PUB-016 proof surface),
  `apply_spans`/`spans_for_strings` (digest-bound scope — the record carries
  `removed_sha256`, never the removed text), `RedactionReview` (accept-only,
  reviewer **role** — `@`/handle-shaped identifiers refused, Part VIII §0.7 —
  timestamp + scope-bound), `RedactionDerivative` (the descriptor capture
  metadata carries), `apply_redaction` (review required or
  `RedactionReviewRequired`; self-checks the removed text is absent from the
  derivative's bytes AND extracted text; binary containers refused — no fake
  overlay "redaction" of a PDF/PNG/WACZ).
- **`evidence/src/evidence/tiers.py`** — `publishable_excerpt` +
  `CaptureMetadata.derivative`: `restricted` still yields the `[redacted]`
  literal, `sealed` still yields metadata only, and a `public` capture with a
  derivative serves **the derivative's** recorded excerpt — fail-closed to
  `None` where the derivative binds none, never the parent's raw text.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/capture_ocfl.py`** — `put_derivative`: the
  derivative lands as a NEW content-addressed OCFL object carrying the
  `sig.redaction-review/1` applied record (`redaction.json`) and a
  parent/method/role summary on `metadata.json`.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/redaction_pipeline.py`** (new) — the wired path:
  `propose_redaction` enqueues a `kind="redaction"` `review_item` whose payload
  binds parent, spans (offsets + removed-bytes digests), method, version;
  `run_redaction` requires the item's latest recorded decision to be a human
  `accept` — nothing, or a reject, refuses loudly — verifies the stored parent
  digest matches the reviewed one, applies through `apply_redaction`, and
  writes the derivative via `put_derivative`. The pipeline never writes a
  decision (never self-approves); the spine insert of the derivative
  `evidence_capture` row stays the caller's act under the review record.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/cli.py`** — `sig-connectors redact-propose` /
  `redact-apply` (queue via `--queue-json` or `--dsn`; exit 3 when no recorded
  accept — the gate-style refusal).
- **`api/src/api/store_pg.py`** — `PgReadStore.capture` populates `excerpt`
  from the `claim_evidence` binding and `derivative` from the newest
  `parent_capture_id`-linked row (uuidv7 order); a pre-`redaction_version`
  spine degrades honestly to `None`. The API evidence representation now names
  the derivative (`redaction_derivative`) and serves its excerpt.
- **`exports/src/exports/dossier.py`** — `DocumentRef.for_capture` builds a ref
  with the publishable (derivative-sourced) excerpt + emits
  `derivative_capture_digest`; the dossier JSON the web layer consumes carries
  it (the web dossier contract has no separate excerpt field — grep-verified).
- **`exports/pyproject.toml`** — `sig-evidence` added (leaf dep; no cycle).
- **Tests** — `tests/evidence/test_redaction.py` (+9: extraction proofs,
  review-required/rejected refusal, role-not-identifier, scope binding, digest
  record, binary refusal, malformed spans); `tests/evidence/test_tiers.py` (+3:
  derivative excerpt served, fail-closed no-excerpt, restricted/sealed
  unchanged); `tests/connectors/test_redaction_pipeline.py` (8: end-to-end
  over a real OCFL root, parent untouched, re-redaction = new derivative,
  drift refusal); `tests/connectors/test_redact_cli.py` (4: verbs incl. exit-3
  unreviewed); `tests/api/test_api_honesty.py` (+1: the API serves the
  derivative excerpt); `tests/exports/test_dossier.py` (+3:
  `for_capture`); `tests/db/test_redaction_pipeline_pg.py` (Docker: real
  sqitch-deployed spine + `PgReviewQueue` + `PgReadStore` + OCFL round-trip —
  the staging leg).
- **CHANGELOG** — Unreleased/Added entry stamped.

## Out of scope

The redaction decisions themselves (a human reviews the proposal on the queue;
this row wires the mechanism and decides nothing); any hosted-store write or
spine insert of a real derivative (operator-driven under the review record);
binary-container redaction (a PDF/PNG/WACZ is refused — a format-aware redactor
is a separate act); the Part VIII at-rest audit (P34.49 owns scanning/sealing);
the officer-naming gate (P35.28); §45.2 takedown mechanics (P35.55).
